H1.dependent: payload plus shared-model bytes per independent family
H1.null: No byte reduction at matched required fidelity

H2.independent: catalog size, reuse and device cohort
H2.dependent: full lifecycle USD per watched hour

H3.dependent: cold start and sustained activation nanoseconds
H3.null: No activation-time improvement at matched fidelity

H4.null: Any critical distinction loss rejects preservation

H5.dependent: blinded source-recovery accuracy, false merges and total cost

H6.independent: fixed pair, decoder-only or paired evolution
H6.dependent: heldout fidelity-qualified bytes, latency, energy and total search cost

metrics.human_rubric: Blinded per-field preservation; two independent reviewers; report agreement and disagreements
metrics.multiple_tests: Report six hypotheses separately; no omnibus success from isolated gains

sample_plan.power: Estimate variance on dev families, then freeze final sample plan before opening holdout; 100 clips is an inventory floor, not a statistical power assertion
